item.name: Loss Aversion
item.fact: Loss aversion is a behavioral bias where individuals are more negatively affected by the prospect of losing money than by the prospect of gaining an equivalent amount.

citations.quote_or_locus: As a behavioral bias known as "Loss Aversion," it states that people are more negatively affected by the prospect of losing money than they are by the prospect of gaining it.
The psychophysics of value induce risk aversion in the domain of gains and risk seeking in the domain of losses.
